Joseph Furphy, Such Is Life.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/joseph-furphy/such-is-life

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Joseph Furphy, the author, died 1912.

First publication of the text used: 1903 (SE colophon: 'Such Is Life was published in 1903 by Joseph Furphy.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1903, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1998.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1912 or earlier (the last to die, Joseph Furphy, in 1912), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
